# Firebase JavaScript SDK

`firebase-app.js`, `firebase-auth.js`, `firebase-firestore.js` and `firebase-storage.js` from the `firebase` npm package, version 13.1.0
(the browser module builds), copied here so the app only loads scripts from its own origin.
The only change is the import path: `https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/13.1.0/firebase-app.js`
became `./firebase-app.js`, and the source map comments were removed.
